module: Bridge between the game and the FMOD audio engine on the GE side. On each render (onPreRender), it pushes global parameters (camera speed and rotation, time of day, wind, player vehicle speed, interior camera, underwater, height above ground and sea, audio blur). It also provides functions to initialize and drive a vehicle's engine/exhaust sounds, and handles the audio blur when a mission menu is open.
notes: onPreRender alternates on each call (frameFlag) between two batches of parameters: one frame out of two for g_Tod, g_WindSpeedMS, g_CamRotationAngle, g_VehicleSpeedPlayerMS; the other for g_CamOnboard, c_CabinFilterReverbStrength, g_CamFree, g_CamUnderwater, g_UnderwaterDepth, g_CamHeightToGround, g_CamHeightToSea. g_GameAudioBlur, g_CamSpeedMS and g_CamRotationSpeedMS are updated every frame.
Time of day: tod.time is 0 at noon, 0.25 at 6 pm, 0.5 at midnight, 0.75 at 6 am; the code converts it to hours (0 to 24) for g_Tod.
g_CamOnboard = AudioInsideModifier (setting) to the power of 4, multiplied by the result of core_camera.isCameraInside.
The downward castRayStatic ray for g_CamHeightToGround is limited to 200 m.
Automatic audio blur is only enabled while an interaction with a mission marker is in progress (missionMarkerInteraction, set by onActivityAcceptGatherData).
The "debugEnabled" comment says to change the line to enable audio blur logs; the variable is local and equals false.

cabinFilterStrength.desc: Cabin filter/reverb strength (0 to 1, clamped when sent) for the interior camera of the player vehicle. Default 1. Written by setCabinFilterStrength.

onPreRender.desc: Render hook. Updates the global FMOD parameters (Engine.Audio.getGlobalParams) if available. See notes for the list of parameters.

dtSim.desc: Simulated duration (s); if 0, camera speeds are not updated.

initEngineSound.desc: Initializes a vehicle's engine sound: vehicle:engineSoundInit, then sets wet_level = 0 and dry_level = 1. Does nothing if the vehicle does not exist.

jsonPath.desc: Path of the sound description file.

nodeIdArray.desc: Emitter node(s); a single number is wrapped into a table.

noloadVol.desc: Volume at no load, 1 by default.

initExhaustSound.desc: Like initEngineSound but for the exhaust, with node pairs. Also calls vehicle:engineSoundInit (same engine call).

nodeIdPairArray.desc: Table of node pairs; a single number becomes {{n, n}}.

noloadVol.desc: Volume at no load, 1 by default.

setEngineSoundParameterList.desc: Sets several engine sound parameters at once.

setExhaustSoundNodes.desc: Changes the exhaust sound emitter nodes (vehicle:engineSoundNodes).

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when settings change: re-reads AudioInsideModifier.

onUiChangedState.desc: Hook called when the UI state changes. If a mission marker is active, handles gameAudioBlurValue: 1 while interacting with the mission UI, reset to 0 for transitions to play (from scenario.start, menu, fadeScreen, blank) or to scenario.end.

onMissionInfoChangedState.desc: Hook called when the mission info window changes state: switching to 'opened' enables the interaction; 'opened' to 'closed' disables it and resets the blur to 0. No effect if no mission marker is active.

onActivityAcceptGatherData.desc: Hook called when an activity gathers its acceptance data. Remembers whether any of the items is of type "mission".

elemData.desc: List of items with a type field.

onMissionAvailabilityChanged.desc: Hook: if data.missionCount is 0, disables the mission interaction.

setCabinFilterStrength.desc: Sets cabinFilterStrength, but only if objId is player vehicle 0. Typically called from the vehicle VM.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: when player 0's vehicle changes, runs sounds.updateCabinFilter() in the new vehicle's VM.

player.desc: Player index; ignored if different from 0.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after Lua extensions are reloaded: reruns sounds.updateCabinFilter() on all vehicles to restore cabinFilterStrength.

setAudioBlur.desc: Manually sets the value of the global audio blur (parameter g_GameAudioBlur).

value.desc: 0 = no blur, 1 = maximum blur (inferred from code).
